main_measure.name: pooled 5-bar forward return, extreme (component>=8) minus neutral (RSI 40-60)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if below 0 with t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 of the 3 coins; reject if >= 0

supporting_check.name: mean per-coin cumulative strategy return minus same-average-size short hold (passed if positive for every coin)

decided_by: Fewer than 30 pooled non-overlapping extreme cases or fewer than 8 for some coin, which is inconclusive whatever the sign.
reading: Extreme bars use the recorded component >= 8 while neutral bars use Wilder RSI(14) recomputed from each window's closes (40 <= RSI <= 60, extreme bars excluded), both sampled on the 0,5,10,... grid per window; with only 2 coins in the record 'negative in at least 2 of the 3 coins' requires both to be negative; the supporting check compounds per-bar gains within windows against a short of the mean absolute allocation and passes only if positive for every coin.
